    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "NRG = energy (Greek energeia, 'activity'); Park = Middle English parc, from Old French parc, 'enclosure'",
    "reading": "Enclosed field of active force; a bounded space where power is gathered and released",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "grc"],
    "source": "OED; Liddell-Scott Greek Lexicon",
    "confidence": 0.8
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "NRG → 'en-er-gee'; Park → 'parc' (Fr.) → 'parque' (Sp.) → 'park' (Eng.)",
    "reading": "Energy in the park; the humming of the earth's own current within a green boundary",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "es"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "NRG → 'nrg' (Greek nergos, 'without work')? No; 'nrg' as 'en-erg' → 'in-erg' (Latin in + ergon, 'work')",
    "reading": "In-work; the place where the inner work of transformation is performed outdoors",
    "languages": ["en", "la", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "NRG PARK → 'RANK GRP' → 'GRP RANK' → 'PARK GRN' (green park) → 'GRN' = green",
    "reading": "Green park; the verdant rank of energies arranged in order, a living hierarchy of power",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "N = north, R = right, G = ground; P = power, A = axis, R = rotation, K = key",
    "reading": "North-right ground; power-axis-rotation-key — a turning point on the earth's magnetic field",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "N (14th letter) + R (18th) + G (7th) = 39; P (16) + A (1) + R (18) + K (11) = 46; total 85",
    "reading": "85 as 8+5=13, death and rebirth; the park as a threshold between old and new cycles",
    "languages": ["en", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "NRG = 14+18+7 = 39; PARK = 16+1+18+11 = 46; 39+46 = 85; 8+5 = 13; 1+3 = 4",
    "reading": "Four as stability, the four corners of the park; energy grounded in a square of order",
    "languages": ["en", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Park (Old English pearroc, 'enclosure for animals') from Germanic; NRG as 'energy' from Greek energeia",
    "reading": "Enclosure for living force; a pen for the wild power that must be tamed to serve",
    "languages": ["en", "grc", "gem"],
    "source": "OED; Bosworth-Toller Anglo-Saxon Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.7
  }
]
